Question: Why is pregnancy becoming difficult and a big issue these days?
Answer: Is it really so? We keep reading that the incidence of abortion is increasing. So that means so many more women are becoming pregnant when they don't want to be pregnant. As the number of pregnancies per family are going down to one or two .Here are the reasons: The age at which women are planning to get pregnant is advancing . The WHO states that chance of natural conception goes down by 50 percent at the age of 35 as compared to age 25. Since the family is going down every pregnancy is “precious” in a way. People are more aware of quality of life issues. The parents want to see to it that they keep no stone unturned regarding the baby' s health right from intruterine life. In general pregnancy had become an “event” and not remained just a physiological function.

Question: What is the procedure of taking pregnancy test step by step?
Answer: Thanks for A2A. Science behind the test: The test detects presence of pregnancy hormone beta HCG in urine. If the hormone is present in blood in sufficient amount only then it will come in urine. There are very few conditions which produce this hormone in the body, pregnancy being the most common cause. Timing of the test: Wait for atleast 5 days after missing the period. Urine sample collected in the morning is preferred but not mandatory. Urine collection: Collect urine in any dry and clean container. Check the urine pregnancy kit The card kit is better than strips ( which are less available any ways). Check the kit for expiry , read instructions on the card. Open it only when you are ready with collected urine. If the card gets dried it can give erroneous results. The test: Use a dropper to put 3 drops of urine in the well on the card. Check for 2 lines at C and T. If both lines are present the test is positive which means the HCG hormone is present which means that the woman is pregnant. One dark and one faint line This could be evaporation line. It means that the kit has dried and showing faint pink line. This could also be the case if the value of hormone is less… usually if the test is done too early. So repeat the test after few days. Important questions: 1 Can one get positive test when not pregnant? 2 Does the positive test mean that it is a good pregnancy? No it means that one is pregnant. It may still land up into miscarriage if that is destined. 3 Can male have this test positive? Never unless erroneous test . There are few cancers which can cause this hormone. In such case the test can come positive. 4 Can one test pet’s urine for pregnancy on this kit? No. The animals, even if pregnant, do not produce HUMAN chorionic gonadotropin. So the test cannot be used.

Question: Should fibroids be removed?
Answer: Most of the fibroids are small, non cancerous and cause no symptoms. Such fibods need not be removed or even trated. Those fibroids which cause trouble need to be treated. Treatment means medicines or surgery. Only small precentage if fibroids need surgical removal.
